name: auth-page
title: Sign-in page
description: The site's sign-in and sign-up page: Black with the site's own light images in two corners bobbing slowly, two ASCII crops from 1024, the lockup bar, the form centered in the height left, and the proof row of marks under it.
use_for: Sign-in and sign-up screens; `mode` picks the copy, `onProvider` and `onEmail` (events in web components) take the presses.
never: A third-party logo shipped in the provider button or the proof row: pass the marks you may show
More than one White button in a view
Real people or customers in the copy: Acme only
Light that keeps moving with reduced motion
source: Site app/(auth) and pages/Auth (AuthShell, AuthForm, AuthProof, Auth.module.css): the lights public/brand/light/auth-light-*.webp at min(29vw, 520px) (144px, top right only, on phones), 11:16, bobbing 12px over 14s on --ease-drift; ASCII drifts 36% by 44% from 1024; the bar 64/72px with the 20px lockup; main centered with 64px between the form and the proof row, 32px in
body: `sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`form`, `proof`); a key left out is not shown.

examples.name: SignUp
examples.label: Sign up
examples.content:
<!-- The sign-up page as the site sets it, with Acme's copy, a neutral mark in the provider button and Acme placeholder marks. -->
<spyglass-auth-page id="auth-up" mode="sign-up"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-key-round" slot="provider-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.586 17.414A2 2 0 0 0 2 18.828V21a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h3a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-1a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h1a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-1a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h.172a2 2 0 0 0 1.414-.586l.814-.814a6.5 6.5 0 1 0-4-4z"></path><circle cx="16.5" cy="7.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle></svg></spyglass-auth-page>
<script type="module">
  const page = document.getElementById('auth-up')
  page.addEventListener('provider', (event) => event.preventDefault())
  page.addEventListener('email', (event) => event.preventDefault())
</script>
